messages:
sam_support: FYI, AcmeApps on prod is getting a bunch of 429s + elevated p99 latency since the model rollout last night. Customer reporting errors in their logs at ~15:12 UTC. Can we triage?

sam_support: quick snapshot from them:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-qa-8k","input":"...","max_tokens":512}'
```

jen_support: which tenant id + route? any billing/auth errors in their UI?

sam_support: tenant=acme-prod, route=/v1/generate, model=gptx-qa-8k (pinned). No billing errors reported, auth OK. They said it started after yesterday's model variant rollout.

monitorbot: [Alert] quota.burst_exhausted (tenant=acme-prod) — 429 spike at 2025-09-12T15:12:10Z, 1m breach. Alert link: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/CB-8721

alex_platform: Can someone pull per-route+model QPS and 429 rate around that window? easiest is Prometheus:
```
sum(rate(req_total{tenant="acme-prod"}[1m])) by (route,model)
sum(rate(resp_status{tenant="acme-prod",code="429"}[1m])) by (route,model)
```

maria_sre: looking at the rate-limiter logs now. seeing repeated: `token_bucket.consume failed tokens=0 capacity=100 burst=500` for acme-prod at 15:12:08-15:14:00. snippet:
```
2025-09-12T15:12:09Z INFO rate_limiter tenant=acme-prod route=/v1/generate tokens=0 -> 429 request_id=rc-9a3
2025-09-12T15:12:11Z INFO rate_limiter tenant=acme-prod route=/v1/generate tokens=0 -> 429 request_id=rc-9b1
```

priya_sre: initial hypothesis: burst window exhausted due to a short, high-concurrency spike (client-side retry storm?) + slightly higher per-token latency on the new variant. Need: sequence length/avg tokens, concurrency, retry behavior. Temporary mitigations: 1) short burst increase for acme-prod, 2) enable soft-fallback to quantized variant, or 3) instruct customer to add exponential backoff.

sam_support: repro details from customer: they send 8 concurrent requests/s during batch job ramp, typical input ~1.5k tokens, they do 3 quick retries with 1s backoff. sample body:
```
{"model":"gptx-qa-8k","input":"<~1.5k tokens>","max_tokens":512}
```

alex_platform: that concurrency * token-size combo explains token CPU pressure. Also check routing: are some requests being routed to the full fp16 variant? tag to check: `model_variant` in traces. If fallback happened, load could concentrate on a heavier variant.

jen_support: for observability, we should add a small dashboard panel: 429 rate and total reqs by tenant/route/model + burst token bucket fill. Suggested PromQL panels + alert rule:
- 429 rate: `sum(rate(resp_status{code="429"}[5m])) by (tenant,route,model) / sum(rate(req_total[5m])) by (tenant,route,model)`
- Alert if 429 rate > 0.05 for 5m AND tenant != internal

maria_sre: i already ran a quick query to fingerprint the burst pattern:
```
topk(10, sum(increase(req_total{tenant="acme-prod"}[5m])) by (route,model))
```
result: /v1/generate:gptx-qa-8k accounted for 78% of the increase.

priya_sre: suggested short-term plan:
• Apply tenant temporary burst boost (2x) for 15m -> reduces immediate 429s
• Enable quantized fallback for heavy inputs for next 24h
• Create dashboard panels + alert as jen suggested
• Ask customer to reduce retry aggressiveness

sam_support: please do the burst boost now if that's low risk — customer is paying; need quick relief.

alex_platform: applying burst boost for acme-prod -> PATCHed policy; change_id=chg-5523. will monitor.

monitorbot: [Change] chg-5523 applied: tenant=acme-prod burst_multiplier=2 expires=2025-09-12T15:30:00Z

maria_sre: after boost, 429s dropped to near-zero within 30s, p99 latency still slightly elevated (~1.8s -> 2.4s). keeping an eye for 10m.

sam_support: awesome — forwarding this to customer and asking them to hold off aggressive retries. thanks all. :thumbsup:

jen_support: follow-ups: create the dashboard (i'll do) + add a runbook link to the tenant page that documents burst attribution steps and contact for escalation.

alex_platform: i'll schedule a param change to prefer quantized variant for inputs >1k tokens for acme-prod. low-risk rollout.

priya_sre: add-on: collect `model_variant` tag in traces for next 48h for forensic correlation.

sam_support: ETA on runbook/dashboard?

jen_support: dashboard + alert in 45m, runbook PR in 2h.

sam_support: great — marking this as triaged, will ping if customer sees more 429s.

maria_sre: added note to thread: how to attribute later if 429s recur — look at `token_bucket.*` metrics, `req_total` per route/model, and correlate with `model_variant` in traces. also see runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/burst-attribution

sam_support: thanks everyone. closing in the thread but will reopen if it resurfaces.
